tables.name: cost_center
tables.description: Operational cost centers for budgeting and organizational financial allocation.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human readable cost center department name.

tables.name: employee
tables.description: Comprehensive employee record including organizational hierarchy, geography, and authority.

fields.name: country
fields.validation_rule: Enum IN, US, UK, DE, SG

fields.name: manager_id
fields.validation_rule: FK to Employee self or empty for CEO

fields.name: is_finance_approver
fields.description: Whether employee has Finance sign-off authority.

fields.name: is_hr_approver
fields.description: Whether employee has HR sign-off authority.

tables.name: holiday_calendar
tables.description: Statutory and public holidays by country used for business-day computations.

fields.name: is_half_day
fields.description: Whether the holiday counts as a half working day.

tables.name: leave_policy
tables.description: Formal leave policy governing accrual, entitlements, notice periods, and limits.

fields.name: carry_forward_max
fields.description: Maximum days carried into subsequent calendar year.

fields.name: min_notice_days
fields.description: Lead time required before leave commences.

fields.name: requires_doc_after_days
fields.description: Consecutive days after which medical certificate is mandatory.

tables.name: leave_balance_ledger
tables.description: Immutable, append-only journal of all leave accrual, consumption, and adjustment events.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Day delta (+ for credit, - for debit).

tables.name: leave_balance
tables.description: Point-in-time materialized balance derived purely from the leave ledger.

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.description: Valuation date of the balance calculation.

fields.name: pending_days
fields.description: Days currently tied in pending requests.

tables.name: leave_request
tables.description: Formal leave application submitted by an employee with calendar and business duration metrics.

fields.name: weekend_days_in_span
fields.description: Count of Saturdays and Sundays in interval.

fields.name: holiday_days_in_span
fields.description: Count of official holidays in interval.

tables.name: leave_request_event
tables.description: Immutable audit trail of state transitions for each leave application.

tables.name: expense_policy
tables.description: Corporate travel and business expense policy rules and threshold ceilings.

fields.name: receipt_required_threshold
fields.description: Threshold above which receipt is mandatory (e.g. 25.00).

fields.name: max_claim_amount
fields.description: Absolute ceiling per claim before special board escalation.

fields.name: equipment_auto_approval_limit
fields.description: IT equipment limit requiring department head signoff.

tables.name: expense_claim
tables.description: Expense claim header aggregating line items with cost center allocation and derived amounts.

fields.name: total_amount_local
fields.description: Total claim amount in local currency.

fields.name: total_amount_base
fields.description: Total claim amount normalized to base USD.

fields.name: line_count
fields.description: Number of constituent expense line items.

tables.name: expense_line
tables.description: Granular expense item including currency conversion and embedded cryptographic receipt metadata.

fields.name: exchange_rate_to_base
fields.description: Fixed currency conversion rate to USD.

fields.name: receipt_hash
fields.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of receipt metadata.

tables.name: expense_claim_event
tables.description: Immutable lifecycle audit log for expense claim state changes.

tables.name: approval_rule
tables.description: Configurable business rules defining required authority, tier thresholds, and approval steps.

fields.name: min_duration_days
fields.description: Minimum leave duration for rule applicability.

fields.name: step_number
fields.description: Sequential step index in multi-level workflow.

tables.name: approval_rule_category
tables.description: N:M bridge linking ApprovalRules to applicable expense categories.

tables.name: approval_rule_country
tables.description: N:M bridge linking ApprovalRules to applicable employee country jurisdictions.

tables.name: approval_step
tables.description: Materialized approval step recording individual approver decision, timestamp, and audit trail.

tables.name: employee_cost_center_assignment
tables.description: Historical and current mapping of employees to cost centers with effective date bounds.

tables.name: decision_log
tables.description: Exhaustive decision audit log capturing reason codes, applied rules, and inputs snapshots.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Target leave request or expense claim ID.

fields.name: rule_id
fields.description: Triggering policy or approval rule ID.

fields.name: inputs_snapshot_json
fields.description: Serialized snapshot of input parameters evaluated.

tables.name: reimbursement
tables.description: Disbursement records issued exclusively for fully approved, eligible expense claims.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total disbursed amount (sum of approved lines).
